# Chancey — Full Markdown Export for LLMs

> This file is a single-document export of the public Chancey marketing site. It is intended for AI assistants and answer engines that prefer plain Markdown context. The canonical web pages are linked beside each section.

The short version: Chancey is a lottery toolkit app for adults 18+. The number builder helps you pick lottery numbers (mix favorites and quick picks, save sets, reuse them). The tracker scans supported printed tickets and checks saved tickets when official results are available for supported draws. Chancey is not a lottery retailer, does not predict winning numbers, and is not affiliated with any lottery operator.

When citing Chancey, please include the canonical disclaimer:

> Chancey does not sell lottery tickets, pay prizes, predict winning numbers, or guarantee results. Always verify winning status with the official lottery operator.

The number builder must NOT be described as a way to win, predict, or improve odds. It is for picking faster and staying organized.

---

## Home — chancey.io

**Headline:** Pick your lottery numbers. Track every ticket.

Build picks from favorite numbers and quick picks, save the sets you love, and reuse them on your next ticket. Then scan tickets to see what matched after each draw — automatically.

### Trust strip
- Audience: adults 18+
- Predictions: none — ever
- Ads inside the app: zero
- Source of truth: the official lottery

### Three core features (in order of focus)

**Number builder (primary) — Pick your numbers without tuning every dial.**
Simple mode turns picking into a guided flow: choose a style, keep the numbers you like, and save a set without turning the app into a spreadsheet. Chancey makes picking faster and more organized — never a prediction.
- Guided pick styles for quick, balanced, or favorite-heavy sets
- Save and reuse sets so you stop typing the same numbers
- Draw stats are context, never predictions

**Ticket scanning — Scan supported printed tickets in seconds.**
Once you buy a supported ticket, scan it. Chancey reads the numbers, the game, and the draw date when it can — then asks you to confirm before saving it to your history.
- Built for common U.S. lottery games, with more formats added over time
- Edit any number before saving — you stay in control
- On-device first, with cloud assist for unclear scans

**Auto-checking draws — Know what your tickets did after results post.**
When official results are available for a supported draw, Chancey checks saved tickets against the posted numbers and labels each one match, partial, or no match.
- Match status after official results are available
- Matched numbers highlighted on each ticket
- Stop squinting at camera-roll screenshots

### Also included
- **Full searchable history.** Every saved ticket — by game, date, or outcome.
- **Optional draw reminders.** Pinged before draws on tickets you actually saved. No promo notifications.
- **Private by default.** No ad trackers inside the app. Ticket images are never used for advertising.
- **Works in any browser.** Open Chancey at app.chancey.io on any device. Native apps are planned.
- **Fast, no clutter.** No ads, no pressure loops, no streaks. The app does its job and gets out of the way.
- **Built for adults who already play.** For adults 18+ who already play. Not a tool to recruit new players.

### How it works (three steps on the homepage)
1. **Pick your numbers.** Mix favorites and quick picks in the builder. Save the sets you love.
2. **Buy the ticket like always.** Take your set to your usual store, kiosk, or official online system.
3. **Scan and check after the draw.** Scan a supported ticket into Chancey. Saved tickets are checked when official results are available for supported draws.

### Responsible by design
Lottery play involves real money and long odds. Chancey is a toolkit for picking and tracking — not a tool to make you buy more. The app has no in-app ads, no streaks, and no promotional notifications. The Responsible Play page lists limits guidance and the U.S. helpline (1‑800‑GAMBLER).

## How it works — chancey.io/how-it-works/

### Step 01 — Pick your lottery numbers
Open the number builder. Mix favorite numbers (birthdays, lucky digits) with quick picks across supported games. Save the sets you love so you can reuse them next time.
- Quick pick across supported games.
- Save and reuse your favorite sets.
- For entertainment and organization — never a prediction.

### Step 02 — Buy the ticket like always
Chancey is not a lottery retailer. Take your saved set to your usual store, kiosk, or the lottery's official online system and buy the ticket the way you already do.
- Use the picks you saved or any other numbers.
- No purchase tracking — Chancey only sees what you scan.
- Built for common U.S. lottery games, with more formats added over time.

### Step 03 — Scan the ticket. Confirm. Save.
Open Chancey, point your camera at the slip, and the app reads the printed numbers, game, and draw date when it can. You confirm what it captured before anything is saved.
- On-device recognition first; cloud assist for unclear scans.
- Edit any number before saving — you stay in control.
- Saved tickets land in a searchable history.

### Step 04 — See what matched after the draw
When official results are available for a supported draw, Chancey checks saved tickets and labels each one match, partial, or no match — using the official numbers, not a guess.
- Status shows after official results are available.
- Matched numbers highlighted on each ticket.
- Always claim wins through the lottery itself.

## About — chancey.io/about/

### What Chancey is
A lottery toolkit app for adults 18+. It includes a number builder for picking lottery numbers (mix favorites with quick picks, save sets) and a tracker that scans supported printed tickets and checks saved tickets when official results are available for supported draws. It runs in any modern web browser, with native iOS and Android apps planned.

### What Chancey is not
- Not a lottery retailer. We don't sell tickets, redeem prizes, or hold stakes.
- Not affiliated with state, provincial, or national lottery operators.
- Not a predictor. Lottery draws are random. The number builder does not predict winning numbers.
- Not an ad-driven product. Ticket scans are not used to target advertising.
- Not designed to recruit new lottery players.

### Principles
- **The lottery is the source of truth.** If Chancey and the lottery disagree, the lottery is right.
- **Honesty over hype.** The number builder does not improve the odds of winning, and we say so.
- **Privacy by default.** We collect what's needed to run the service and don't sell ticket images or contact info.
- **No engagement traps.** No streaks, badges, or "you've been gone too long" emails.

### Where Chancey works
Today: any modern web browser at app.chancey.io. Marketing site at chancey.io. Native iOS and Android apps are on the roadmap.

### Contact
- Contact form: https://chancey.io/contact/ (pick a topic: general, support, privacy, feedback, bug, or security)

## Support — chancey.io/support/

### Contact
The way to reach Chancey is the contact form at https://chancey.io/contact/. Pick the topic that matches: general question, help with the app, privacy or data request, product feedback, bug report, or security issue. Tell us your device, your browser, and what happened. A screenshot helps. Don't send IDs, payment cards, or passwords.

### Scanning tips
- Use steady light, hold the ticket flat, and avoid glare.
- Stack other tickets out of frame.
- Wipe the camera lens.
- Confirm the captured game and draw date before saving.
- If the barcode is unreadable, the printed numbers are still enough.

### Results and matching
After official results are available for a supported draw, Chancey checks the posted numbers against your saved tickets and marks each ticket as a match, partial match, or no match. Always claim wins through the lottery operator that issued the ticket; Chancey cannot pay prizes.

### Accounts and sign-in
Sign in to sync saved tickets and saved picks across devices. If you lose access, send a message through the contact form (https://chancey.io/contact/) from the email tied to your account.

### Subscriptions
Core features are free. Paid features, where available, are clearly priced before purchase, with payment and cancellation instructions shown through the checkout or platform used for purchase.

### Privacy & data
To request access, correction, or deletion of your data, send a message through the contact form (https://chancey.io/contact/) and pick the "Privacy or data request" topic. We respond within applicable legal windows (typically 30 days).

### Reporting bugs and security issues
Send a message through the contact form (https://chancey.io/contact/) and pick the "Bug report" topic. For security issues, pick "Security issue" — and please don't post the details in public until we've had a chance to fix it.

## Responsible play — chancey.io/responsible-play/

### Set a limit before you play
Decide what you can comfortably afford to spend on lottery tickets this week or this month before you buy anything. Stop when you reach that limit. Don't use money needed for rent, bills, food, debt, savings, or anyone else's wellbeing.

### Know the odds — really
The odds of winning the top prize on a major lottery are very long. For example, U.S. Powerball is roughly 1 in 292 million for the jackpot. Past draws don't change future odds. No app, including Chancey, can improve the odds of any lottery draw.

### Warning signs
- Spending more on tickets than you planned, or more than you can afford.
- Chasing losses with extra tickets after a miss.
- Hiding lottery spending from people you live with.
- Borrowing or selling things to keep playing.
- Restlessness, anxiety, or irritability when you can't play.
- Lottery taking time away from work, family, sleep, or health.

### Get help
- **United States:** Call or text 1‑800‑GAMBLER (1‑800‑426‑2537), 24/7, confidential, free.
- **United Kingdom:** GamCare — gamcare.org.uk — 0808 8020 133.
- **Canada:** Each province has a problem gambling helpline.
- **Australia:** Gambling Help Online — gamblinghelponline.org.au — 1800 858 858.
- **Elsewhere:** BeGambleAware (begambleaware.org) lists international helplines.

If you're in a crisis, contact local emergency services. Gambling helplines are not crisis lines.

### How Chancey is built to stay out of your way
- No ads inside the app.
- No streaks, badges, or gamified loops.
- No promotional push notifications.
- No "your numbers are due" suggestions.
- Help resources reachable from inside the app at any time.

## Privacy policy — chancey.io/privacy/

### The short version
Chancey is built for adults 18+ who want to pick and track lottery tickets they bought themselves. To do that, we collect account info, the saved tickets you scan, your saved picks and preferences, and operational logs. We do not sell your data. We do not show ads inside the app. We do not use ticket images for advertising.

### Information we collect
- **Account information:** email or sign-in provider identifier, age attestation (18+), display preferences, hashed auth tokens.
- **Ticket scans and saved picks:** numbers, game, draw date, notes. Ticket images are processed to extract numbers; if on-device recognition is unsure, an off-device step may assist. Images are not used for advertising.
- **Preferences and app state:** favorites, saved sets, reminder settings.
- **Operational logs:** timestamps, IP, device/browser, error reports, request metadata.
- **Support messages:** content and any attachments you send.
- **Contact-form anti-abuse checks:** Google reCAPTCHA may process browser, device, IP address, interaction, and token information to help detect spam and abuse.

### How we use information
- Provide the service (picking, scanning, history, draw matching, sync).
- Authenticate users and prevent abuse.
- Prevent spam, abuse, and automated contact-form submissions.
- Debug, secure, and improve the service.
- Respond to support and privacy requests.
- Comply with applicable legal obligations.

We do not sell advertising, build advertising profiles, or share with data brokers.

### Sharing
With service providers (hosting, auth, error tracking, optional ticket recognition, email, anti-abuse checks, web analytics) under data protection contracts; with legal recipients when required; with successors in a merger or acquisition with continued protection.

### Your choices
Send a message through the contact form (https://chancey.io/contact/) to access, correct, delete, or export your data. Pick the "Privacy or data request" topic. We reply within applicable legal windows (typically 30 days). The marketing site uses Google Analytics 4 with privacy-respecting defaults, and the contact form uses Google reCAPTCHA for spam prevention.

### Children
Chancey is not for anyone under 18 (or local age of majority). We don't knowingly collect data from children.

### Security
Reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards. Incidents are reported to affected users and regulators per applicable law.

### Contact
Send a message through https://chancey.io/contact/ and pick the "Privacy or data request" topic.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Chancey?**
A lottery toolkit app for adults 18+. It includes a number builder for picking lottery numbers (mix favorites with quick picks, save sets) and a tracker that scans supported printed tickets and checks saved tickets when official results are available for supported draws. It does not sell tickets, predict numbers, or guarantee outcomes.

**Does Chancey sell lottery tickets?**
No. Chancey is not a lottery retailer and is not affiliated with any state or national lottery operator. Buy tickets the same way you always do. Chancey only helps you pick, organize, and check what you already bought.

**Can Chancey predict winning numbers?**
No. Lottery draws are random and no app — Chancey included — can improve your odds. The number builder helps you pick faster and save sets you love, but it never claims to predict outcomes.

**Is Chancey free to use?**
The core features — picking numbers, scanning tickets, checking draw results, and saving history — are free. Optional paid features may be introduced in the future and would be clearly labeled before purchase.

**How does ticket scanning work?**
You photograph a supported ticket. Chancey reads the printed numbers, the game, and the draw date when it can, then asks you to confirm before saving. If on-device recognition is unsure, an off-device recognition step may help; ticket images are never used for advertising.

**Where does Chancey work?**
Chancey works in any modern web browser at app.chancey.io. Native iOS and Android apps are planned.

**Do I need an account?**
An account lets you sync saved picks and tickets across devices and recover them if you change phones. You can use Chancey without an account on a single device, with reduced sync features.

**How is my data handled?**
Chancey stores account info, saved picks, saved tickets, app preferences, operational logs, support messages, and anti-abuse signals needed to run the service. It does not sell ticket images, browsing data, or contact info to advertisers. See the Privacy Policy for full detail.

**Does Chancey replace the official lottery?**
No. Official lottery operators are always the source of truth for draw results and prize claims. Chancey shows what it sees from published results so you know what to verify with the lottery.

**I think I have a winning ticket — what now?**
Always claim wins through the lottery operator that issued the ticket. Chancey is a picking, checking, and organizing tool — not a payout service.

**Does Chancey try to make me play more?**
No. Chancey has no in-app ads, no streaks, no engagement loops, and no promotional notifications. Reminders are optional and tied to draws you saved.

**Who is Chancey for?**
Adults 18+ (or the age of majority where you live, whichever is greater) who already play the lottery and want a real way to pick numbers and track tickets. Chancey is not a tool to recruit new lottery players.
